notes.title: UPDATE #21 - DIG DIG DIG!

[h1]UPDATE #21 is now available![/h1]

This update added a new mechanic - digging sand with a shovel. Sand piles are now generated in the world, which can be dug up to find loot. Perhaps the same madman who painted all the wheel rims buried the items.
The sleep mechanics were completely rewritten - I got rid of the extra window (the window with the time selection), you can now "wake up" the character at any time by pressing [SPACE]. Also fixed a bug when the character needed only 1 hour to get enough sleep. Now it takes 8 hours to completely fill the sleep bar.
Initially, barrels were added to the game so that you don't have to carry a bunch of canisters, but carry one or two barrels. But for some reason, everyone started carrying 10 barrels, somehow fitting them into the trunk. This was not intended, so the spawn of barrels was reduced. The amount of fluids generated inside them has also been reduced.
I get a lot of messages about the impossibility of adding fluids to the engine/radiator. To do this, you just need to open the lid. I had to add a corresponding notification to avoid confusion.

Hello, Drivers! ːsteamhappyː

[h1]UPDATE #14 BETA is now available in beta branch![/h1]

The previous cars - Farmer, Wrangel and Cobra - have returned to the game - they can now be found traveling around the world. As soon as you find any of these cars, they will be permanently added to your parking lot in the starting location.
The economy in the game has been globally revised - it was very strange that in the desert some paint costs more than water. Prices for items are still in the process of being balanced.
The character needs system has been changed, it will be more difficult to play on the standard difficulty setting, but you can always customize the game for yourself. This system is also in the balancing stage.
Car tuning has been slightly expanded - side mirrors have been added that can be installed on car doors. Like other items, they can also be found in places of interest.
A small bonus - a trash can has started working in the starting garage (it is next to the sofa) - by placing unnecessary trash in it and closing the lid, it will be removed from the game. Even in the post-apocalyptic world, you can now keep things clean!)

[h2][i]IMPORTANT![/i][/h2]
